proposal.ruling_text: Retry the build. Build-01 correctly gated with the approved tree’s snapshotted `[tests].run`, so the item’s own change to that command could not govern the invocation already in progress; that old command selected the newly marked own-records test and produced the recorded failure. The committed implementation passed its criterion and remains non-empty relative to approval. On the retry, `cmd_build` starts from commit 3418772, reads the new `-m 'not own_records'` command, and the existing retry mechanism permits the inherited valid commit to pass without requiring another commit.
